panel.title: Scheduled reports
panel.subtitle: Reports generated and sent automatically. Each recipient receives a copy built from the data they are allowed to see.
panel.emptyHint: Schedule a report to send it every month or week to managers, HR or anyone in the organisation.

schedule.subtitle: Choose the report, when it runs and who receives it.
schedule.name: Name
schedule.namePlaceholder: e.g. Monthly attendance for branch managers
schedule.typeInvalid: Choose a report that can be scheduled.
schedule.periodInvalid: This period does not fit the report or the frequency.
schedule.customInvalid: The period runs from a day of the previous month to an earlier day (e.g. 26 → 25).
schedule.deleteHint: “{{name}}” stops running. Reports already sent stay with their recipients.

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.scopeNote: Each recipient gets the report for the data they can access — a manager their team, a branch manager their branches. Employees without report access receive the report about themselves only; anybody else without access is skipped.

share.title: Send report
share.subtitle: {{report}} will be generated for each recipient and sent to them.
share.queuedHint: Each copy is generated in the background; follow them in the delivery log.

log.title: Delivery log
log.emptyHint: Every scheduled run and every report sent from this page is listed here, one row per recipient.

skip.outside_scope: The filters are outside their access
skip.outside_self: The report is about other people (they can only receive their own)

download.noExport: Downloading reports needs the export permission.
